claim: Zwin Nature Park is at Graaf Léon Lippensdreef 8, Knokke-Heist; adult tickets are €12 online / €14 on site and €6 for children aged 6-17; summer opening is 10am-6pm seven days a week.
quote: During summer, visits are from 10 am to 6 pm, 7 days a week. … Adults pay €12 online or €14 on site, and children ages 6-17 pay €6.

claim: A day ticket gives access to the permanent exhibition on bird migration, the cabin trail, the observation centre, the panorama tower (360° view), the temporary exhibition, and the Zwin Plain.
quote: A day ticket gives you access to the permanent exhibition on bird migration, the cabin trail, the observation centre, the panorama tower, the temporary exhibition, and the Zwin Plain.

claim: The 1.7 km cabin trail features themed cabins (lab, island, listening) where visitors examine microscopic creatures, view waterbirds and distinguish bird sounds; the observation centre has interactive screens for ID'ing birds on the mudflats.
quote: The cabin trail is a 1.7-kilometre walk through the Zwin Nature Park past experience points and themed cabins, where you can observe microscopic creatures in the lab cabin, get up close to waterbirds in the island cabin, and learn to distinguish between bird sounds in the listening cabin.

claim: Over 300 bird species have been recorded at the Zwin, making it one of Belgium's most species-rich birding spots; autumn migration peaks from August through November.
quote: Well over 300 bird species have been recorded in the Zwin, making it one of the most species rich birding spots in the country. During August autumn migration goes on more heavily and continues well into November.

claim: Zwin hosts Belgium's oldest White Stork breeding colony (9-16 pairs 2018-2023) and was enlarged in 2019 when 120 ha of farmland was converted back to saltmarsh; winter counts exceed 20,000 waterbirds.
quote: an area of 120 hectares of farmland was converted back to saltmarsh and added to the reserve. … The reserve hosts a breeding White Stork population of 9-16 pairs (2018-2023).

claim: Spring International Migration Days fall on 11-12 May and the EuroBirdWatch autumn weekend on 5-6 October, with guides on the Zwin Plain and ringing demos 10:00-12:00.
quote: The EuroBirdWatch weekend at the Zwin will take place on Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 October. Ringing demonstrations are available from 10:00 to 12:00 … During the International Migration Days, on 11 and 12 May, guides will be available.

claim: The Zwinduinen en -polders reserve covers 222 hectares and forms a natural transition between sea, beach and polders; trails for hiking, cycling and horse riding are kept separate.
quote: The Zwin dunes and polders form a 222-hectare natural transition between the sea, beach, and polders, connecting to the Zwin Nature Park. … You can hike, cycle, and go horse riding here on separate paths.

claim: The 12 km circular Zwin walking route (3h30, easy) loops from the visitor centre through the Kleyne Vlakte polders, Oude Hazegraspolder and Koningsbos; Konik horses and Highland cattle graze the Kleyne Vlakte to keep it open.
quote: The Kleyne Vlakte, a large fossil sandy plain, is the southernmost part of the Zwinduinen and polders. Since the end of the 19th century this area has been separated from the sea by the construction of the Internationale Dijk. Herds of Koniks and Scottish Highland cattle help keep the area open.

claim: The Zwin walking trail is 13.3 km long with a shorter 9.2 km loop option and lies outside the paid Zwin Nature Park so no ticket is needed.
quote: The Zwin walking trail is 13.3-km long but you can also follow a shorter, 9.2-km loop, and as this trail is not situated in the Zwin Nature Park, you don't need to buy a ticket to take this walk.

claim: The new semi-paved four-metre-wide path along the Internationale Zwindijk links Knokke-Heist with Cadzand in the Netherlands and is promoted as Belgium's most beautiful cycling highway with views over the Zwin plain.
quote: The new, semi-paved four-metre-wide cycling and walking path offers unrivalled views of the Zwin Plain and the surrounding polder landscape. The Internationale Zwindijk is Belgium's most beautiful cycling highway, linking Knokke-Heist with Cadzand.

claim: Zwin Nature Park sits about 5 km northeast of Knokke centre; bus-and-walk access requires roughly a 3.5 km walk from the bus stop; a free 2.8 km circular walk from Surfers' Paradise beach bar lets visitors see the area without a ticket.
quote: Zwin Nature Park is located about 5km northeast of Knokke … If you don't have a car, you can take a bus to Knokke and then walk approximately 3.5 km to the park entrance. … a thoroughly upgraded 2.8km circular walk that starts down the promenade from Knokke's Surfers' Paradise beach bar.

claim: Within Zwinduinen en -polders, Ulrich Rückriem's Four Stone Pillars sculpture (48 tons of Austrian granite) is a cultural waypoint alongside the restored Kleyne Vlakte wetland that supports rare species like tree frogs.
quote: The Four Stone Pillars, an art installation by sculptor Ulrich Rückriem using 48 tons of Austrian granite, provides cultural interest within the natural setting. … the Kleyne Vlakte, a restored wetland habitat supporting rare species like tree frogs.
